answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making cheap clones fail a three-part admission gate. At the kernel of enrollment, each identity must lock a bond large enough that spinning thousands of aliases is uneconomic, then publish a replayable work mirror so peers can check that past actions actually happened under one key. Bonds are released only after a slow cooling window measured against a public quartz clock, so burst-created sockpuppets cannot vote or grade before the stake is at risk long enough to be slashed.
